definitions.explanation: A horizontal or vertical line of text in writing, printing, or on a screen. Used when referring to specific positions in documents, code, or printed material.
A row of the Japanese syllabary chart (五十音図), grouping kana that share the same consonant.

examples.japanese: ⟦{次|つぎ}→次：00819_tsugi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{行|ぎょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}んで→読む：00426_yomu⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{文章|ぶんしょう}→文章：02957_bunshou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{全部|ぜんぶ}→全部：02888_zenbu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{何行|なんぎょう}⟦あります→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: How many lines does this passage have in total?

examples.japanese: ⟦{三|さん}→三：00749_san⟧{行目|ぎょうめ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{最初|さいしょ}→最初：00882_saisho⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{単語|たんご}→単語：03413_tango⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{誤|あやま}り→誤り：01772_ayamari⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{修正|しゅうせい}して→修正する：25527_shuuseisuru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: There is an error in the first word on the third line, so please correct it.

examples.japanese: {五十音図|ごじゅうおんず}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{各行|かくぎょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{五|いつ}つ→五つ：02892_itsutsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧かな⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{並|なら}んでいる→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧。
examples.english: Each row of the kana chart has five kana lined up.
The 'sa row' includes the five sounds 'sa, shi, su, se, so.'

notes:
Read as ぎょう, this word refers to a line of text or a row in a chart. Do not confuse with other readings of the same kanji: ⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧ (to go), ⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧ (to carry out), or {行|こう} (used in compounds like ⟦{銀行|ぎんこう}→銀行：00578_ginkou⟧).

As a counter, {行|ぎょう} counts lines of text: {一行|いちぎょう} (one line), {二行|にぎょう} (two lines), {三行|さんぎょう} (three lines). The suffix {行目|ぎょうめ} specifies the ordinal position: {一行目|いちぎょうめ} (first line).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {行|ぎょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{変|か}える→変える：01089_kaeru⟧: to start a new line
- ⟦{行|ぎょう}{間|かん}→行間：07324_gyoukan⟧: line spacing
- {空白行|くうはくぎょう}: blank line
- {行|ぎょう}⟦{番号|ばんごう}→番号：02939_bangou⟧: line number
- ⟦{改行|かいぎょう}→改行：16256_kaigyou⟧: line break; new line

KANA CHART USAGE:
In the {五十音図|ごじゅうおんず}, each consonant group is called a {行|ぎょう}: {あ行|あぎょう}, {か行|かぎょう}, {さ行|さぎょう}, etc. Each column is called a ⟦{段|だん}→段：03424_dan⟧ (だん): {あ段|あだん}, {い段|いだん}, etc.
